# login-state reads, and a scan that records every new process in user.slice, /non-systemd or an fx1459 unit.

RECF=$D/record.txt
BOOT=$(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
while read -r k v; do [[ $k == btime ]] && BT=$v; done < /proc/stat
now(){ local t=$EPOCHREALTIME; printf '%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%sZ' "${t%.*}" "${t#*.}"; }
say(){ echo "$(now) $*"; }
declare -A SEEN
# cmdl <pid>: the process's argv joined by spaces, cut to 80 characters, in REPLY (bash builtins only).
cmdl(){ local -a a; { mapfile -d '' -t a < /proc/$1/cmdline; } 2>/dev/null; REPLY="${a[*]}"; REPLY=${REPLY:0:80}; }
# rp <label> <pid>: record one process by pid and its starttime (field 22 of /proc/<pid>/stat, clock ticks since boot).
rp(){
  local raw; { raw=$(</proc/$2/stat); } 2>/dev/null || { say "REC-MISS label=$1 pid=$2 (gone before it could be read)"; return 0; }
  local rest=${raw##*) }; local -a f=($rest); local st=${f[19]}
  local key="$2:$st"; [[ -n ${SEEN[$key]} ]] && return 0; SEEN[$key]=1
  local cs=$(( BT*100 + st )); local line
  printf -v line 'REC host=wsl boot=%s pid=%s starttime=%s created=%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%02dZ recorded=%s label=%s' "$BOOT" "$2" "$st" "$((cs/100))" "$((cs%100))" "$(now)" "$1"
  echo "$line"; [[ -d $D ]] && echo "$line" >> "$RECF"
}
# recnew <label>: record every live process whose cgroup is in user.slice, /non-systemd or an fx1459 unit, not yet recorded.
recnew(){
  local p cg
  for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do
    p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue
    { cg=$(</proc/$p/cgroup); } 2>/dev/null || continue
    case $cg in *user.slice*|*non-systemd*|*fx1459*) cmdl $p; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p";; esac
  done
}
# recall <label>: record every live process (used when this script's own connection booted the distro).
recall(){ local p; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; cmdl $p; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; done; }
# start_record: record this script, its /init parents, and either the whole boot (if this connection booted WSL) or the new processes.
start_record(){
  local raw; raw=$(</proc/$$/stat); local rest=${raw##*) }; local -a f=($rest); MYST=${f[19]}
  say "script pid $$ ppid $PPID starttime $MYST boot_id $BOOT btime $BT uptime $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)"
  rp "script:$TAG" $$; rp "init-parent" $PPID; local r2; r2=$(</proc/$PPID/stat); local -a g=(${r2##*) }); rp "init-grandparent" "${g[1]}"
  if (( MYST < 1500 )); then say "this connection booted the distro (script started ${MYST} ticks after boot): recording every process"; recall "boot"; else recnew "new"; fi
}
# winrec <label>: record, through interop, this connection's Windows process chain and any WSL VM process started since it began.
winrec(){ say "winrec $1"; /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand "$(sed "s/__TAG__/$TAG/;s/__LABEL__/$1/" $D/winrec.ps1 | iconv -t UTF-16LE | base64 -w0)" | tr -d '\r' | tee -a "$RECF"; }
login_state(){
  say "LOGIN STATE ($1)"; echo '$ loginctl list-sessions --no-pager'; loginctl list-sessions --no-pager
  echo '$ loginctl show-user [name withheld] --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service'; loginctl show-user [name withheld] --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service 2>&1
  echo '$ systemctl is-active [name withheld]'; systemctl is-active [name withheld]
}
wsl_alive(){ say "WSL instance: boot_id $(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id) uptime $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime) s ($1)"; }
# user_sessions: ids of [name withheld]'s sessions other than the user manager's own (class manager).
user_sessions(){ loginctl list-sessions --no-legend --no-pager | awk '$3=="[name withheld]" && $6!="manager" {print $1}'; }
# foreign_[name withheld] processes outside the user manager's own init.scope and outside this spike's fx1459 units. Prints them; returns 0 if any.
foreign_[name withheld](){
  local p u cg any=1
  for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null) || continue; [[ $u == 1000 ]] || continue
    { cg=$(</proc/$p/cgroup); } 2>/dev/null || continue
    case $cg in *[name withheld]/init.scope*|*fx1459*) continue;; esac
    echo "[name withheld] process outside the manager and the spike's units: pid $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-100) | $cg"; any=0
  done; return $any
}

# ---- s1 body: make the spike directory, write its files, fetch Node, record what started.
TAG=fx1459s1
start_record
mkdir -p $D/runs
chown [name withheld] $D $D/runs
touch $RECF; chown [name withheld] $RECF; chmod 666 $RECF
say "spike directory $D"
base64 -d > $D/lib.sh <<'B64'
[base64 copy of lib.sh withheld; its masked source is under source/]
B64
echo "laptop sha256 [sha256 withheld]  lib.sh"
base64 -d > $D/fixture.sh <<'B64'
[base64 copy of fixture.sh withheld; its masked source is under source/]
B64
echo "laptop sha256 4168bc32e46289e70c4651e891a2c39bd0a98871b73d212433060bbf4645fad4  fixture.sh"
base64 -d > $D/list.cjs <<'B64'
[base64 copy of list.cjs withheld; its masked source is under source/]
B64
echo "laptop sha256 [sha256 withheld]  list.cjs"
base64 -d > $D/supervisor.cjs <<'B64'
[base64 copy of supervisor.cjs withheld; its masked source is under source/]
B64
echo "laptop sha256 [sha256 withheld]  supervisor.cjs"
base64 -d > $D/writer.cjs <<'B64'
[base64 copy of writer.cjs withheld; its masked source is under source/]
B64
echo "laptop sha256 [sha256 withheld]  writer.cjs"
base64 -d > $D/winrec.ps1 <<'B64'
[base64 copy of winrec.ps1 withheld; its masked source is under source/]
B64
echo "laptop sha256 6e053411632d1c4b8c5337cedb48699485f27977d9e4d55a4f5419d8f8669cbf  winrec.ps1"
cd $D && sha256sum lib.sh fixture.sh list.cjs supervisor.cjs writer.cjs winrec.ps1
say "fetch Node"
curl -fsSLo node.tar.xz https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.19.0/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64.tar.xz && curl -fsSLo SHASUMS256.txt https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.19.0/SHASUMS256.txt
grep " node-v24.19.0-linux-x64.tar.xz$" SHASUMS256.txt | sed "s/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64.tar.xz/node.tar.xz/" | sha256sum -c -
python3 -c 'import tarfile,sys; tarfile.open(sys.argv[1]).extractall(sys.argv[2], filter="tar")' node.tar.xz $D && rm node.tar.xz SHASUMS256.txt
chown -R [name withheld] $D
echo "$ $D/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node --version"; $D/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node --version
ls -la $D
recnew "end"
winrec s1-end
say "s1 done"

# ABOUTME: Card #1459 helpers inlined at the top of every root script sent to WSL: UTC timestamps, the process record (pid,
# starttime, boot id), login-state reads, and a scan that records only the spike's own processes.
export TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C
TU=rigger-spike
D=/home/$TU/1459-spike-engineer
RECF=$D/record.txt
NODE=$D/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node
BOOT=$(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
while read -r k v; do [[ $k == btime ]] && BT=$v; done < /proc/stat
now(){ local t=$EPOCHREALTIME; printf '%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%sZ' "${t%.*}" "${t#*.}"; }
say(){ echo "$(now) $*"; }
declare -A SEEN
# cmdl <pid>: the process's argv joined by spaces, cut to 80 characters, in REPLY (bash builtins only).
cmdl(){ local -a a; { mapfile -d '' -t a < /proc/$1/cmdline; } 2>/dev/null; REPLY="${a[*]}"; REPLY=${REPLY:0:80}; }
# st <pid>: sets STF to the fields of /proc/<pid>/stat after the command name (STF[1] ppid, STF[19] starttime). Fails if gone.
st(){ local raw; { raw=$(</proc/$1/stat); } 2>/dev/null || return 1; STF=(${raw##*) }); }
# rp <label> <pid>: record one process by pid and starttime (field 22 of /proc/<pid>/stat, clock ticks since the VM's boot).
rp(){
  st "$2" || { say "REC-MISS label=$1 pid=$2 (gone before it could be read)"; return 0; }
  local s=${STF[19]} key="$2:${STF[19]}"; [[ -n ${SEEN[$key]} ]] && return 0; SEEN[$key]=1
  local cs=$(( BT*100 + s )) line
  printf -v line 'REC host=wsl boot=%s pid=%s starttime=%s created=%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%02dZ recorded=%s label=%s' "$BOOT" "$2" "$s" "$((cs/100))" "$((cs%100))" "$(now)" "$1"
  echo "$line"; [[ -d $D ]] && echo "$line" >> "$RECF"
}
# mine <pid>: true if the process is the spike's own: a descendant of this script, owned by the user under test, in an fx1459
# unit or the user under test's slice, or in root's user slice and started no earlier than 3 s before this script.
mine(){
  local p=$1 cg u; { cg=$(</proc/$p/cgroup); } 2>/dev/null || return 1
  case $cg in *fx1459*|*user-$TUID.slice*) return 0;; esac
  u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null); [[ -n $TUID && $u == "$TUID" ]] && return 0
  if [[ $cg == *user-0.slice* ]]; then st $p && (( STF[19] >= MYST - 300 )) && return 0; fi
  local q=$p n=0; while (( q > 1 && n < 64 )); do [[ $q == "$$" ]] && return 0; st $q || return 1; q=${STF[1]}; ((n++)); done
  return 1
}
# recnew <label>: record every live process of the spike's own (see mine) not yet recorded.
recnew(){ local p; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; mine $p && { cmdl $p; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; }; done; }
# recboot <label>: when this connection started the distro, record every process of that start except [name withheld]'s (uid 1000) and
# sshd's per-connection processes, which belong to [name withheld]'s own sessions and user manager and are not the spike's.
recboot(){ local p u; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null) || continue; [[ $u == 1000 ]] && continue; cmdl $p; [[ $REPLY == [name withheld]* ]] && continue; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; done; }
# start_record: record this script and its /init parents; and, if the distro's pid 1 started less than 10 s before this
# script, every process of that distro start (recboot); then the spike's own processes.
start_record(){
  st $$; MYST=${STF[19]}; st 1; P1ST=${STF[19]}; TUID=$(id -u $TU 2>/dev/null)
  say "script pid $$ ppid $PPID starttime $MYST; distro pid 1 starttime $P1ST; boot_id $BOOT btime $BT; user under test $TU uid ${TUID:-none}"
  rp "script:$TAG" $$; rp "init-parent" $PPID; st $PPID; rp "init-grandparent" "${STF[1]}"
  if (( MYST - P1ST < 1000 )); then say "this connection started the distro (pid 1 started $((MYST - P1ST)) ticks before this script): recording that start, except [name withheld]'s processes"; recboot "boot"; fi
  recnew "start"
}
# winrec <label>: record, through interop, this connection's Windows process chain and any WSL VM process started since it began.
winrec(){ say "winrec $1"; /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand "$(sed "s/__TAG__/$TAG/;s/__LABEL__/$1/" $D/winrec.ps1 | iconv -t UTF-16LE | base64 -w0)" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | grep -v -e '^#< CLIXML' -e '^<Objs' | tee -a "$RECF"; }
login_state(){
  say "LOGIN STATE ($1)"; echo '$ loginctl list-sessions --no-pager'; loginctl list-sessions --no-pager
  echo "\$ loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service"; loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service 2>&1
  echo "\$ systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service"; systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service
}
wsl_alive(){ st 1; say "WSL instance ($1): boot_id $(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); distro pid 1 starttime ${STF[19]}; uptime $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime) s"; }
# tu_sessions: ids of the user under test's sessions other than its user manager's own (class manager).
tu_sessions(){ loginctl list-sessions --no-legend --no-pager | awk -v u=$TU '$3==u && $6!="manager" {print $1}'; }

# ABOUTME: Card #1459 helpers inlined at the top of every root script sent to WSL: UTC timestamps, the process record (pid,
# starttime, boot id), login-state reads, and a scan that records only the spike's own processes.
export TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C
TU=rigger-spike
D=/home/$TU/1459-spike-engineer
RECF=$D/record.txt
NODE=$D/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node
BOOT=$(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
while read -r k v; do [[ $k == btime ]] && BT=$v; done < /proc/stat
now(){ local t=$EPOCHREALTIME; printf '%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%sZ' "${t%.*}" "${t#*.}"; }
say(){ echo "$(now) $*"; }
declare -A SEEN
# cmdl <pid>: the process's argv joined by spaces, cut to 80 characters, in REPLY (bash builtins only).
cmdl(){ local -a a; { mapfile -d '' -t a < /proc/$1/cmdline; } 2>/dev/null; REPLY="${a[*]}"; REPLY=${REPLY:0:80}; }
# st <pid>: sets STF to the fields of /proc/<pid>/stat after the command name (STF[1] ppid, STF[19] starttime). Fails if gone.
st(){ local raw; { raw=$(</proc/$1/stat); } 2>/dev/null || return 1; STF=(${raw##*) }); }
# rp <label> <pid>: record one process by pid and starttime (field 22 of /proc/<pid>/stat, clock ticks since the VM's boot).
rp(){
  st "$2" || { say "REC-MISS label=$1 pid=$2 (gone before it could be read)"; return 0; }
  local s=${STF[19]} key="$2:${STF[19]}"; [[ -n ${SEEN[$key]} ]] && return 0; SEEN[$key]=1
  local cs=$(( BT*100 + s )) line
  printf -v line 'REC host=wsl boot=%s pid=%s starttime=%s created=%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%02dZ recorded=%s label=%s' "$BOOT" "$2" "$s" "$((cs/100))" "$((cs%100))" "$(now)" "$1"
  echo "$line"; [[ -d $D ]] && echo "$line" >> "$RECF"
}
# mine <pid>: true if the process is the spike's own: a descendant of this script, owned by the user under test, in an fx1459
# unit or the user under test's slice, or in root's user slice and started no earlier than 3 s before this script.
mine(){
  local p=$1 cg u; { cg=$(</proc/$p/cgroup); } 2>/dev/null || return 1
  case $cg in *fx1459*|*user-$TUID.slice*) return 0;; esac
  u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null); [[ -n $TUID && $u == "$TUID" ]] && return 0
  if [[ $cg == *user-0.slice* ]]; then st $p && (( STF[19] >= MYST - 300 )) && return 0; fi
  local q=$p n=0; while (( q > 1 && n < 64 )); do [[ $q == "$$" ]] && return 0; st $q || return 1; q=${STF[1]}; ((n++)); done
  return 1
}
# recnew <label>: record every live process of the spike's own (see mine) not yet recorded.
recnew(){ local p; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; mine $p && { cmdl $p; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; }; done; }
# recboot <label>: when this connection started the distro, record every process of that start except [name withheld]'s (uid 1000) and
# sshd's per-connection processes, which belong to [name withheld]'s own sessions and user manager and are not the spike's.
recboot(){ local p u; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null) || continue; [[ $u == 1000 ]] && continue; cmdl $p; [[ $REPLY == [name withheld]* ]] && continue; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; done; }
# start_record: record this script and its /init parents; and, if the distro's pid 1 started less than 10 s before this
# script, every process of that distro start (recboot); then the spike's own processes.
start_record(){
  st $$; MYST=${STF[19]}; st 1; P1ST=${STF[19]}; TUID=$(id -u $TU 2>/dev/null)
  say "script pid $$ ppid $PPID starttime $MYST; distro pid 1 starttime $P1ST; boot_id $BOOT btime $BT; user under test $TU uid ${TUID:-none}"
  rp "script:$TAG" $$; rp "init-parent" $PPID; st $PPID; rp "init-grandparent" "${STF[1]}"
  if (( MYST - P1ST < 1000 )); then say "this connection started the distro (pid 1 started $((MYST - P1ST)) ticks before this script): recording that start, except [name withheld]'s processes"; recboot "boot"; fi
  recnew "start"
}
# winrec <label>: record, through interop, this connection's Windows process chain and any WSL VM process started since it began.
winrec(){ say "winrec $1"; /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand "$(sed "s/__TAG__/$TAG/;s/__LABEL__/$1/" $D/winrec.ps1 | iconv -t UTF-16LE | base64 -w0)" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | grep -v -e '^#< CLIXML' -e '^<Objs' | tee -a "$RECF"; }
login_state(){
  say "LOGIN STATE ($1)"; echo '$ loginctl list-sessions --no-pager'; loginctl list-sessions --no-pager
  echo "\$ loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service"; loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service 2>&1
  echo "\$ systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service"; systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service
}
wsl_alive(){ st 1; say "WSL instance ($1): boot_id $(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); distro pid 1 starttime ${STF[19]}; uptime $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime) s"; }
# tu_sessions: ids of the user under test's sessions other than its user manager's own (class manager).
tu_sessions(){ loginctl list-sessions --no-legend --no-pager | awk -v u=$TU '$3==u && $6!="manager" {print $1}'; }
# ---- case driver body. Arguments: <tag> <route r0|rl|rs> <cases...>. Runs each case for the user under test, as root only to
# set up or revert the route and to observe; every supervisor and fresh writer runs as the user under test.
TAG=$1; ROUTE=$2; shift 2; CASES="$*"
start_record; winrec start; wsl_alive start
UNITF=/etc/systemd/system/fx1459-rs@.service
asuser(){ setpriv --reuid=$TUID --regid=$TUID --init-groups env -i HOME=/home/$TU USER=$TU LOGNAME=$TU PATH=/usr/bin:/bin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$TUID "$@"; }
revert(){
  case $ROUTE in
    rl) say '$ loginctl disable-linger rigger-spike'; loginctl disable-linger $TU; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger;;
    rs) say "revert RS"; systemctl stop 'fx1459-rs@*.service' 2>&1; systemctl reset-failed 'fx1459-rs@*.service' 2>&1; rm -v $UNITF; systemctl daemon-reload; echo '$ systemctl cat fx1459-rs@x.service'; systemctl cat fx1459-rs@x.service 2>&1; ls -la $UNITF 2>&1;;
  esac
}
say "=== ROUTE $ROUTE setup"
login_state "route $ROUTE, before setup"
case $ROUTE in
  r0) echo "R0: the user as created, linger unset"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger;;
  rl) trap revert EXIT; say '$ loginctl enable-linger rigger-spike'; loginctl enable-linger $TU; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger
      for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service) == active ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done; say "user@$TUID: $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service)"; recnew "rl-setup";;
  rs) trap revert EXIT; say "install $UNITF"
      cat > $UNITF <<UNIT
# ABOUTME: Card #1459 route RS: a system unit that runs the supervisor as the unprivileged user under test with a delegated cgroup.
[Unit]
Description=fx1459 RS supervisor %i
[Service]
Type=simple
User=$TU
Group=$TU
Delegate=yes
KillMode=process
WorkingDirectory=$D
ExecStart=$NODE $D/supervisor.cjs %i rs-%i
StandardOutput=append:$D/runs/rs-%i/sup.log
StandardError=append:$D/runs/rs-%i/sup.log
UNIT
      cat $UNITF; systemctl daemon-reload; echo "daemon-reload exit $?";;
esac
waitlog(){ local f=$1 pat=$2 n=$3; for ((i=0;i<n*10;i++)); do grep -qE "$pat" $f 2>/dev/null && return 0; sleep 0.1; done; return 1; }
alive_rec(){ st $1 && [[ ${STF[19]} == "$2" && ${STF[0]} != Z ]]; }
supinfo(){ local l; l=$(grep -m1 '^REC .*label=supervisor:' $R/sup.log); SUP=$(sed -E 's/.* pid=([0-9]+) .*/\1/' <<<"$l"); SUPST=$(sed -E 's/.* starttime=([0-9]+) .*/\1/' <<<"$l"); TREE=$(grep -m1 ' TREE ' $R/sup.log | awk '{print $3}'); }
listing(){ asuser $NODE $D/list.cjs $RUN "driver: $1" 2>&1; }
end_survivors(){
  local who pid start
  while read -r _ who pid start _; do [[ $who == *from-root* ]] && continue; if alive_rec $pid $start; then kill -9 $pid && say "cleanup: ended recorded $who pid $pid (starttime $start)"; fi; done < <(grep '^MEMBER' $R/members.txt 2>/dev/null)
  [[ -n $SUP ]] && alive_rec $SUP $SUPST && kill -9 $SUP && say "cleanup: ended recorded supervisor $SUP"
}
run_case(){
  local c=$1 mode=$1; RUN=$ROUTE-$c; R=$D/runs/$RUN; SUP=; SUPST=; TREE=; H=
  mkdir -p $R; chown $TU:$TU $R
  say "=== CASE $c under $ROUTE (run $RUN)"; wsl_alive "case $RUN start"
  if [[ $c == n2 ]]; then
    say "N2: open a $TU login session through WSL interop: wsl.exe -u $TU -e sleep 8"
    /mnt/c/Windows/System32/wsl.exe -u $TU -e sleep 8 & H=$!; rp "interop wsl.exe shim, $RUN login" $H
    for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ -n $(tu_sessions) ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done; recnew "$RUN-login"
    login_state "$RUN: session open, before supervisor start"
  else
    login_state "$RUN: during the run, before supervisor start"
    if [[ -n $(tu_sessions) ]]; then say "ABORT $RUN: $TU has a login session open"; return; fi
  fi
  if [[ $ROUTE == r0 && $c != n2 ]]; then mode=obtain; fi
  say "start supervisor (mode $mode)"
  case $ROUTE in
    r0) if [[ $c == n2 ]]; then
          echo "\$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN"
          asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
        else
          echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN > $R/sup.log 2>&1   (started directly as $TU with no session: R0 changes nothing)"
          asuser $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN > $R/sup.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
          echo '$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-'$RUN'-unit -p Delegate=yes --working-directory='$D' '$NODE' '$D'/supervisor.cjs obtain '$RUN; asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN-unit -p Delegate=yes --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
        fi;;
    rl) echo "\$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN"
        asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?";;
    rs) echo "\$ systemctl start fx1459-rs@$c.service"; systemctl start fx1459-rs@$c.service; echo "exit $?";;
  esac
  waitlog $R/sup.log 'READY|RESULT' 30; recnew "$RUN-supervisor"
  say "supervisor log so far:"; cat $R/sup.log; supinfo
  if grep -q 'RESULT' $R/sup.log; then say "RESULT for $RUN: $(grep RESULT $R/sup.log)"; recnew "$RUN-end"; return; fi
  [[ -z $SUP ]] && { say "no supervisor record; abandoning $RUN"; end_survivors; return; }
  say "supervisor pid $SUP starttime $SUPST tree $TREE"
  case $c in
    n1) login_state "$RUN: tree running, before the cgroup.kill write"
        touch $R/go; say "trigger written"; waitlog $R/sup.log 'DONE' 40; say "supervisor log:"; sed -n '/trigger seen/,$p' $R/sup.log
        listing "after DONE, at least 12 s after the write";;
    n3) login_state "$RUN: tree running, before the kill"
        listing "before kill -9 of the supervisor"
        if alive_rec $SUP $SUPST; then say "\$ kill -9 $SUP"; kill -9 $SUP; say "kill -9 sent to recorded supervisor $SUP"; fi
        sleep 12; listing "12 s after kill -9 of the supervisor, before the fresh write"
        login_state "$RUN: supervisor killed, before the fresh write"
        echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE"; asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE 2>&1
        sleep 12; listing "12 s after the fresh write";;
    n2) say "supervisor started under the open session; now close every session of $TU"
        wait $H; say "interop login command exited ($?); sessions of $TU: $(tu_sessions | tr '\n' ' ')"
        sleep 2; for s in $(tu_sessions); do say "\$ loginctl terminate-session $s   (its leader is the spike's own login, recorded above)"; loginctl terminate-session $s; echo "exit $?"; done
        for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ -z $(tu_sessions) ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done
        CLOSED=$(now); say "every session of $TU closed at $CLOSED (tu_sessions empty: $([[ -z $(tu_sessions) ]] && echo yes || echo no))"
        for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; a=$(asuser $NODE $D/list.cjs $RUN watch | sed -n 's/.*alive=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p'); echo "$(now) t+${i}s after close: members alive=$a supervisor $(alive_rec $SUP $SUPST && echo alive || echo gone) user@$TUID $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service)"; done
        login_state "$RUN: 30 s after every session closed, before the cgroup.kill write"
        listing "30 s after every session closed, before the cgroup.kill write"
        if alive_rec $SUP $SUPST; then touch $R/go; say "trigger written"; waitlog $R/sup.log 'DONE' 40; say "supervisor log:"; sed -n '/trigger seen/,$p' $R/sup.log
        else say "supervisor $SUP is gone; supervisor log:"; cat $R/sup.log
          if [[ -d $TREE ]]; then echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE"; asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE 2>&1; else say "tree cgroup $TREE does not exist: \$ ls -ld $TREE"; ls -ld $TREE 2>&1; fi
          sleep 12; fi
        listing "at least 12 s after the ending"
        echo "\$ journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso-precise --since @${CASEST} _SYSTEMD_UNIT=systemd-logind.service + UNIT=user@$TUID.service + _SYSTEMD_UNIT=user@$TUID.service"
        journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso-precise --since @${CASEST} _SYSTEMD_UNIT=systemd-logind.service + UNIT=user@$TUID.service + _SYSTEMD_UNIT=user@$TUID.service 2>&1 | tail -60;;
  esac
  recnew "$RUN-end"
  end_survivors
  [[ $ROUTE == rs ]] && { systemctl stop fx1459-rs@$c.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed fx1459-rs@$c.service 2>/dev/null; }
  [[ $ROUTE != rs ]] && systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service >/dev/null && asuser systemctl --user reset-failed fx1459-$RUN.service 2>/dev/null
  sleep 1; listing "after cleanup"; wsl_alive "case $RUN end"
}
for c in $CASES; do CASEST=${EPOCHREALTIME%.*}; run_case $c; done
recnew "end"; login_state "route $ROUTE, end"; winrec end; wsl_alive end; say "driver done"

# ABOUTME: Card #1459 helpers inlined at the top of every root script sent to WSL: UTC timestamps, the process record (pid,
# starttime, boot id), login-state reads, and a scan that records only the spike's own processes.
export TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C
TU=rigger-spike
D=/home/$TU/1459-spike-engineer
RECF=$D/record.txt
NODE=$D/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node
BOOT=$(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
while read -r k v; do [[ $k == btime ]] && BT=$v; done < /proc/stat
now(){ local t=$EPOCHREALTIME; printf '%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%sZ' "${t%.*}" "${t#*.}"; }
say(){ echo "$(now) $*"; }
declare -A SEEN
# cmdl <pid>: the process's argv joined by spaces, cut to 80 characters, in REPLY (bash builtins only).
cmdl(){ local -a a; { mapfile -d '' -t a < /proc/$1/cmdline; } 2>/dev/null; REPLY="${a[*]}"; REPLY=${REPLY:0:80}; }
# st <pid>: sets STF to the fields of /proc/<pid>/stat after the command name (STF[1] ppid, STF[19] starttime). Fails if gone.
st(){ local raw; { raw=$(</proc/$1/stat); } 2>/dev/null || return 1; STF=(${raw##*) }); }
# rp <label> <pid>: record one process by pid and starttime (field 22 of /proc/<pid>/stat, clock ticks since the VM's boot).
rp(){
  st "$2" || { say "REC-MISS label=$1 pid=$2 (gone before it could be read)"; return 0; }
  local s=${STF[19]} key="$2:${STF[19]}"; [[ -n ${SEEN[$key]} ]] && return 0; SEEN[$key]=1
  local cs=$(( BT*100 + s )) line
  printf -v line 'REC host=wsl boot=%s pid=%s starttime=%s created=%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%02dZ recorded=%s label=%s' "$BOOT" "$2" "$s" "$((cs/100))" "$((cs%100))" "$(now)" "$1"
  echo "$line"; [[ -d $D ]] && echo "$line" >> "$RECF"
}
# mine <pid>: true if the process is the spike's own: a descendant of this script, owned by the user under test, in an fx1459
# unit or the user under test's slice, or in root's user slice and started no earlier than 3 s before this script.
mine(){
  local p=$1 cg u; { cg=$(</proc/$p/cgroup); } 2>/dev/null || return 1
  case $cg in *fx1459*|*user-$TUID.slice*) return 0;; esac
  u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null); [[ -n $TUID && $u == "$TUID" ]] && return 0
  if [[ $cg == *user-0.slice* ]]; then st $p && (( STF[19] >= MYST - 300 )) && return 0; fi
  local q=$p n=0; while (( q > 1 && n < 64 )); do [[ $q == "$$" ]] && return 0; st $q || return 1; q=${STF[1]}; ((n++)); done
  return 1
}
# recnew <label>: record every live process of the spike's own (see mine) not yet recorded.
recnew(){ local p; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; mine $p && { cmdl $p; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; }; done; }
# recboot <label>: when this connection started the distro, record every process of that start except [name withheld]'s (uid 1000) and
# sshd's per-connection processes, which belong to [name withheld]'s own sessions and user manager and are not the spike's.
recboot(){ local p u; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null) || continue; [[ $u == 1000 ]] && continue; cmdl $p; [[ $REPLY == [name withheld]* ]] && continue; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; done; }
# start_record: record this script and its /init parents; and, if the distro's pid 1 started less than 10 s before this
# script, every process of that distro start (recboot); then the spike's own processes.
start_record(){
  st $$; MYST=${STF[19]}; st 1; P1ST=${STF[19]}; TUID=$(id -u $TU 2>/dev/null)
  say "script pid $$ ppid $PPID starttime $MYST; distro pid 1 starttime $P1ST; boot_id $BOOT btime $BT; user under test $TU uid ${TUID:-none}"
  rp "script:$TAG" $$; rp "init-parent" $PPID; st $PPID; rp "init-grandparent" "${STF[1]}"
  if (( MYST - P1ST < 1000 )); then say "this connection started the distro (pid 1 started $((MYST - P1ST)) ticks before this script): recording that start, except [name withheld]'s processes"; recboot "boot"; fi
  recnew "start"
}
# winrec <label>: record, through interop, this connection's Windows process chain and any WSL VM process started since it began.
winrec(){ say "winrec $1"; /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand "$(sed "s/__TAG__/$TAG/;s/__LABEL__/$1/" $D/winrec.ps1 | iconv -t UTF-16LE | base64 -w0)" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | grep -v -e '^#< CLIXML' -e '^<Objs' | tee -a "$RECF"; }
login_state(){
  say "LOGIN STATE ($1)"; echo '$ loginctl list-sessions --no-pager'; loginctl list-sessions --no-pager
  echo "\$ loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service"; loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service 2>&1
  echo "\$ systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service"; systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service
}
wsl_alive(){ st 1; say "WSL instance ($1): boot_id $(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); distro pid 1 starttime ${STF[19]}; uptime $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime) s"; }
# tu_sessions: ids of the user under test's sessions other than its user manager's own (class manager).
tu_sessions(){ loginctl list-sessions --no-legend --no-pager | awk -v u=$TU '$3==u && $6!="manager" {print $1}'; }
# ---- case driver body. Arguments: <tag> <route r0|rl|rs> <cases...>. Runs each case for the user under test, as root only to
# set up or revert the route and to observe; every supervisor and fresh writer runs as the user under test.
main(){
TAG=$1; ROUTE=$2; shift 2; CASES="$*"
start_record; winrec start; wsl_alive start
UNITF=/etc/systemd/system/fx1459-rs@.service
asuser(){ setpriv --reuid=$TUID --regid=$TUID --init-groups env -i HOME=/home/$TU USER=$TU LOGNAME=$TU PATH=/usr/bin:/bin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$TUID "$@"; }
revert(){
  case $ROUTE in
    rl) say '$ loginctl disable-linger rigger-spike'; loginctl disable-linger $TU; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger;;
    rs) say "revert RS"; systemctl stop 'fx1459-rs@*.service' 2>&1; systemctl reset-failed 'fx1459-rs@*.service' 2>&1; rm -v $UNITF; systemctl daemon-reload; echo '$ systemctl cat fx1459-rs@x.service'; systemctl cat fx1459-rs@x.service 2>&1; ls -la $UNITF 2>&1;;
  esac
}
say "=== ROUTE $ROUTE setup"
login_state "route $ROUTE, before setup"
case $ROUTE in
  r0) echo "R0: the user as created, linger unset"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger;;
  rl) trap revert EXIT; say '$ loginctl enable-linger rigger-spike'; loginctl enable-linger $TU; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger
      for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service) == active ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done; say "user@$TUID: $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service)"; recnew "rl-setup";;
  rs) trap revert EXIT; say "install $UNITF"
      cat > $UNITF <<UNIT
# ABOUTME: Card #1459 route RS: a system unit that runs the supervisor as the unprivileged user under test with a delegated cgroup.
[Unit]
Description=fx1459 RS supervisor %i
[Service]
Type=simple
User=$TU
Group=$TU
Delegate=yes
KillMode=process
WorkingDirectory=$D
ExecStart=$NODE $D/supervisor.cjs %i rs-%i
StandardOutput=append:$D/runs/rs-%i/sup.log
StandardError=append:$D/runs/rs-%i/sup.log
UNIT
      cat $UNITF; systemctl daemon-reload; echo "daemon-reload exit $?";;
esac
waitlog(){ local f=$1 pat=$2 n=$3; for ((i=0;i<n*10;i++)); do grep -qE "$pat" $f 2>/dev/null && return 0; sleep 0.1; done; return 1; }
alive_rec(){ st $1 && [[ ${STF[19]} == "$2" && ${STF[0]} != Z ]]; }
supinfo(){ local l; l=$(grep -m1 '^REC .*label=supervisor:' $R/sup.log); SUP=$(sed -E 's/.* pid=([0-9]+) .*/\1/' <<<"$l"); SUPST=$(sed -E 's/.* starttime=([0-9]+) .*/\1/' <<<"$l"); TREE=$(grep -m1 ' TREE ' $R/sup.log | awk '{print $3}'); }
listing(){ asuser $NODE $D/list.cjs $RUN "driver: $1" 2>&1; }
end_survivors(){
  local who pid start
  while read -r _ who pid start _; do [[ $who == *from-root* ]] && continue; if alive_rec $pid $start; then kill -9 $pid && say "cleanup: ended recorded $who pid $pid (starttime $start)"; fi; done < <(grep '^MEMBER' $R/members.txt 2>/dev/null)
  [[ -n $SUP ]] && alive_rec $SUP $SUPST && kill -9 $SUP && say "cleanup: ended recorded supervisor $SUP"
}
run_case(){
  local c=$1 mode=$1; RUN=$ROUTE-$c; R=$D/runs/$RUN; SUP=; SUPST=; TREE=; H=
  mkdir -p $R; chown $TU:$TU $R
  say "=== CASE $c under $ROUTE (run $RUN)"; wsl_alive "case $RUN start"
  if [[ $c == n2 ]]; then
    say "N2: open a $TU login session through WSL interop: wsl.exe -u $TU -e sleep 8"
    /mnt/c/Windows/System32/wsl.exe -u $TU -e sleep 8 & H=$!; rp "interop wsl.exe shim, $RUN login" $H
    for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ -n $(tu_sessions) ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done; recnew "$RUN-login"
    login_state "$RUN: session open, before supervisor start"
  else
    login_state "$RUN: during the run, before supervisor start"
    if [[ -n $(tu_sessions) ]]; then say "ABORT $RUN: $TU has a login session open"; return; fi
  fi
  if [[ $ROUTE == r0 && $c != n2 ]]; then mode=obtain; fi
  say "start supervisor (mode $mode)"
  case $ROUTE in
    r0) if [[ $c == n2 ]]; then
          echo "\$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN"
          asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
        else
          echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN > $R/sup.log 2>&1   (started directly as $TU with no session: R0 changes nothing)"
          asuser $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN > $R/sup.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
          echo '$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-'$RUN'-unit -p Delegate=yes --working-directory='$D' '$NODE' '$D'/supervisor.cjs obtain '$RUN; asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN-unit -p Delegate=yes --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
        fi;;
    rl) echo "\$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN"
        asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?";;
    rs) echo "\$ systemctl start fx1459-rs@$c.service"; systemctl start fx1459-rs@$c.service; echo "exit $?";;
  esac
  waitlog $R/sup.log 'READY|RESULT' 30; recnew "$RUN-supervisor"
  say "supervisor log so far:"; cat $R/sup.log; supinfo
  if grep -q 'RESULT' $R/sup.log; then say "RESULT for $RUN: $(grep RESULT $R/sup.log)"; recnew "$RUN-end"; return; fi
  [[ -z $SUP ]] && { say "no supervisor record; abandoning $RUN"; end_survivors; return; }
  say "supervisor pid $SUP starttime $SUPST tree $TREE"
  case $c in
    n1) login_state "$RUN: tree running, before the cgroup.kill write"
        touch $R/go; say "trigger written"; waitlog $R/sup.log 'DONE' 40; say "supervisor log:"; sed -n '/trigger seen/,$p' $R/sup.log
        listing "after DONE, at least 12 s after the write";;
    n3) login_state "$RUN: tree running, before the kill"
        listing "before kill -9 of the supervisor"
        if alive_rec $SUP $SUPST; then say "\$ kill -9 $SUP"; kill -9 $SUP; say "kill -9 sent to recorded supervisor $SUP"; fi
        sleep 12; listing "12 s after kill -9 of the supervisor, before the fresh write"
        login_state "$RUN: supervisor killed, before the fresh write"
        echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE"; asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE 2>&1
        sleep 12; listing "12 s after the fresh write";;
    n2) say "supervisor started under the open session; now close every session of $TU"
        wait $H; say "interop login command exited ($?); sessions of $TU: $(tu_sessions | tr '\n' ' ')"
        sleep 2; for s in $(tu_sessions); do say "\$ loginctl terminate-session $s   (its leader is the spike's own login, recorded above)"; loginctl terminate-session $s; echo "exit $?"; done
        for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ -z $(tu_sessions) ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done
        CLOSED=$(now); say "every session of $TU closed at $CLOSED (tu_sessions empty: $([[ -z $(tu_sessions) ]] && echo yes || echo no))"
        for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; a=$(asuser $NODE $D/list.cjs $RUN watch | sed -n 's/.*alive=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p'); echo "$(now) t+${i}s after close: members alive=$a supervisor $(alive_rec $SUP $SUPST && echo alive || echo gone) user@$TUID $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service)"; done
        login_state "$RUN: 30 s after every session closed, before the cgroup.kill write"
        listing "30 s after every session closed, before the cgroup.kill write"
        if alive_rec $SUP $SUPST; then touch $R/go; say "trigger written"; waitlog $R/sup.log 'DONE' 40; say "supervisor log:"; sed -n '/trigger seen/,$p' $R/sup.log
        else say "supervisor $SUP is gone; supervisor log:"; cat $R/sup.log
          if [[ -d $TREE ]]; then echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE"; asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE 2>&1; else say "tree cgroup $TREE does not exist: \$ ls -ld $TREE"; ls -ld $TREE 2>&1; fi
          sleep 12; fi
        listing "at least 12 s after the ending"
        echo "\$ journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso-precise --since @${CASEST} _SYSTEMD_UNIT=systemd-logind.service + UNIT=user@$TUID.service + _SYSTEMD_UNIT=user@$TUID.service"
        journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso-precise --since @${CASEST} _SYSTEMD_UNIT=systemd-logind.service + UNIT=user@$TUID.service + _SYSTEMD_UNIT=user@$TUID.service 2>&1 | tail -60;;
  esac
  recnew "$RUN-end"
  end_survivors
  [[ $ROUTE == rs ]] && { systemctl stop fx1459-rs@$c.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed fx1459-rs@$c.service 2>/dev/null; }
  [[ $ROUTE != rs ]] && systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service >/dev/null && asuser systemctl --user reset-failed fx1459-$RUN.service 2>/dev/null
  sleep 1; listing "after cleanup"; wsl_alive "case $RUN end"
}
for c in $CASES; do CASEST=${EPOCHREALTIME%.*}; run_case $c; done
recnew "end"; login_state "route $ROUTE, end"; winrec end; wsl_alive end; say "driver done"
}
# main is read in full before it runs, and runs with stdin from /dev/null, so no command it starts can read the rest of this script.
main "$@" < /dev/null

# ABOUTME: Card #1459 helpers inlined at the top of every root script sent to WSL: UTC timestamps, the process record (pid,
# starttime, boot id), login-state reads, and a scan that records only the spike's own processes.
export TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C
TU=rigger-spike
D=/home/$TU/1459-spike-engineer
RECF=$D/record.txt
NODE=$D/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node
BOOT=$(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
while read -r k v; do [[ $k == btime ]] && BT=$v; done < /proc/stat
now(){ local t=$EPOCHREALTIME; printf '%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%sZ' "${t%.*}" "${t#*.}"; }
say(){ echo "$(now) $*"; }
declare -A SEEN
# cmdl <pid>: the process's argv joined by spaces, cut to 80 characters, in REPLY (bash builtins only).
cmdl(){ local -a a; { mapfile -d '' -t a < /proc/$1/cmdline; } 2>/dev/null; REPLY="${a[*]}"; REPLY=${REPLY:0:80}; }
# st <pid>: sets STF to the fields of /proc/<pid>/stat after the command name (STF[1] ppid, STF[19] starttime). Fails if gone.
st(){ local raw; { raw=$(</proc/$1/stat); } 2>/dev/null || return 1; STF=(${raw##*) }); }
# rp <label> <pid>: record one process by pid and starttime (field 22 of /proc/<pid>/stat, clock ticks since the VM's boot).
rp(){
  st "$2" || { say "REC-MISS label=$1 pid=$2 (gone before it could be read)"; return 0; }
  local s=${STF[19]} key="$2:${STF[19]}"; [[ -n ${SEEN[$key]} ]] && return 0; SEEN[$key]=1
  local cs=$(( BT*100 + s )) line
  printf -v line 'REC host=wsl boot=%s pid=%s starttime=%s created=%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%02dZ recorded=%s label=%s' "$BOOT" "$2" "$s" "$((cs/100))" "$((cs%100))" "$(now)" "$1"
  echo "$line"; [[ -d $D ]] && echo "$line" >> "$RECF"
}
# mine <pid>: true if the process is the spike's own: a descendant of this script, owned by the user under test, in an fx1459
# unit or the user under test's slice, or in root's user slice and started no earlier than 3 s before this script.
mine(){
  local p=$1 cg u; { cg=$(</proc/$p/cgroup); } 2>/dev/null || return 1
  case $cg in *fx1459*|*user-$TUID.slice*) return 0;; esac
  u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null); [[ -n $TUID && $u == "$TUID" ]] && return 0
  if [[ $cg == *user-0.slice* ]]; then st $p && (( STF[19] >= MYST - 300 )) && return 0; fi
  local q=$p n=0; while (( q > 1 && n < 64 )); do [[ $q == "$$" ]] && return 0; st $q || return 1; q=${STF[1]}; ((n++)); done
  return 1
}
# recnew <label>: record every live process of the spike's own (see mine) not yet recorded.
recnew(){ local p; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; mine $p && { cmdl $p; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; }; done; }
# recboot <label>: when this connection started the distro, record every process of that start except [name withheld]'s (uid 1000) and
# sshd's per-connection processes, which belong to [name withheld]'s own sessions and user manager and are not the spike's.
recboot(){ local p u; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null) || continue; [[ $u == 1000 ]] && continue; cmdl $p; [[ $REPLY == [name withheld]* ]] && continue; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; done; }
# start_record: record this script and its /init parents; and, if the distro's pid 1 started less than 10 s before this
# script, every process of that distro start (recboot); then the spike's own processes.
start_record(){
  st $$; MYST=${STF[19]}; st 1; P1ST=${STF[19]}; TUID=$(id -u $TU 2>/dev/null)
  say "script pid $$ ppid $PPID starttime $MYST; distro pid 1 starttime $P1ST; boot_id $BOOT btime $BT; user under test $TU uid ${TUID:-none}"
  rp "script:$TAG" $$; rp "init-parent" $PPID; st $PPID; rp "init-grandparent" "${STF[1]}"
  if (( MYST - P1ST < 1000 )); then say "this connection started the distro (pid 1 started $((MYST - P1ST)) ticks before this script): recording that start, except [name withheld]'s processes"; recboot "boot"; fi
  recnew "start"
}
# winrec <label>: record, through interop, this connection's Windows process chain and any WSL VM process started since it began.
winrec(){ say "winrec $1"; /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand "$(sed "s/__TAG__/$TAG/;s/__LABEL__/$1/" $D/winrec.ps1 | iconv -t UTF-16LE | base64 -w0)" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | grep -v -e '^#< CLIXML' -e '^<Objs' | tee -a "$RECF"; }
login_state(){
  say "LOGIN STATE ($1)"; echo '$ loginctl list-sessions --no-pager'; loginctl list-sessions --no-pager
  echo "\$ loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service"; loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service 2>&1
  echo "\$ systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service"; systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service
}
wsl_alive(){ st 1; say "WSL instance ($1): boot_id $(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); distro pid 1 starttime ${STF[19]}; uptime $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime) s"; }
# tu_sessions: ids of the user under test's sessions other than its user manager's own (class manager).
tu_sessions(){ loginctl list-sessions --no-legend --no-pager | awk -v u=$TU '$3==u && $6!="manager" {print $1}'; }
# ---- case driver body. Arguments: <tag> <route r0|rl|rs> <cases...>. Runs each case for the user under test, as root only to
# set up or revert the route and to observe; every supervisor and fresh writer runs as the user under test.
main(){
TAG=$1; ROUTE=$2; shift 2; CASES="$*"
start_record; winrec start; wsl_alive start
UNITF=/etc/systemd/system/fx1459-rs@.service
asuser(){ setpriv --reuid=$TUID --regid=$TUID --init-groups env -i HOME=/home/$TU USER=$TU LOGNAME=$TU PATH=/usr/bin:/bin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$TUID "$@"; }
revert(){
  case $ROUTE in
    rl) say '$ loginctl disable-linger rigger-spike'; loginctl disable-linger $TU; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger;;
    rs) say "revert RS"; systemctl stop 'fx1459-rs@*.service' 2>&1; systemctl reset-failed 'fx1459-rs@*.service' 2>&1; rm -v $UNITF; systemctl daemon-reload; echo '$ systemctl cat fx1459-rs@x.service'; systemctl cat fx1459-rs@x.service 2>&1; ls -la $UNITF 2>&1;;
  esac
}
say "=== ROUTE $ROUTE setup"
login_state "route $ROUTE, before setup"
case $ROUTE in
  r0) echo "R0: the user as created, linger unset"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger;;
  rl) trap revert EXIT; say '$ loginctl enable-linger rigger-spike'; loginctl enable-linger $TU; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger
      for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service) == active ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done; say "user@$TUID: $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service)"; recnew "rl-setup";;
  rs) trap revert EXIT; say "install $UNITF"
      cat > $UNITF <<UNIT
# ABOUTME: Card #1459 route RS: a system unit that runs the supervisor as the unprivileged user under test with a delegated cgroup.
[Unit]
Description=fx1459 RS supervisor %i
[Service]
Type=simple
User=$TU
Group=$TU
Delegate=yes
KillMode=process
WorkingDirectory=$D
ExecStart=$NODE $D/supervisor.cjs %i rs-%i
StandardOutput=append:$D/runs/rs-%i/sup.log
StandardError=append:$D/runs/rs-%i/sup.log
UNIT
      cat $UNITF; systemctl daemon-reload; echo "daemon-reload exit $?";;
esac
waitlog(){ local f=$1 pat=$2 n=$3; for ((i=0;i<n*10;i++)); do grep -qE "$pat" $f 2>/dev/null && return 0; sleep 0.1; done; return 1; }
alive_rec(){ st $1 && [[ ${STF[19]} == "$2" && ${STF[0]} != Z ]]; }
supinfo(){ local l; l=$(grep -m1 '^REC .*label=supervisor:' $R/sup.log); SUP=$(sed -E 's/.* pid=([0-9]+) .*/\1/' <<<"$l"); SUPST=$(sed -E 's/.* starttime=([0-9]+) .*/\1/' <<<"$l"); TREE=$(grep -m1 ' TREE ' $R/sup.log | awk '{print $3}'); }
listing(){ asuser $NODE $D/list.cjs $RUN "driver: $1" 2>&1; }
end_survivors(){
  local who pid start
  while read -r _ who pid start _; do [[ $who == *from-root* ]] && continue; if alive_rec $pid $start; then kill -9 $pid && say "cleanup: ended recorded $who pid $pid (starttime $start)"; fi; done < <(grep '^MEMBER' $R/members.txt 2>/dev/null)
  [[ -n $SUP ]] && alive_rec $SUP $SUPST && kill -9 $SUP && say "cleanup: ended recorded supervisor $SUP"
}
run_case(){
  local c=$1 mode=$1; RUN=$ROUTE-$c; R=$D/runs/$RUN; SUP=; SUPST=; TREE=; H=
  mkdir -p $R; chown $TU:$TU $R
  say "=== CASE $c under $ROUTE (run $RUN)"; wsl_alive "case $RUN start"
  if [[ $c == n2 ]]; then
    say "N2: open a $TU login session through WSL interop: wsl.exe -u $TU -e sleep 8"
    /mnt/c/Windows/System32/wsl.exe -u $TU -e sleep 8 & H=$!; rp "interop wsl.exe shim, $RUN login" $H
    for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ -n $(tu_sessions) ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done; recnew "$RUN-login"
    login_state "$RUN: session open, before supervisor start"
  else
    login_state "$RUN: during the run, before supervisor start"
    if [[ -n $(tu_sessions) ]]; then say "ABORT $RUN: $TU has a login session open"; return; fi
  fi
  if [[ $ROUTE == r0 && $c != n2 ]]; then mode=obtain; fi
  say "start supervisor (mode $mode)"
  case $ROUTE in
    r0) if [[ $c == n2 ]]; then
          echo "\$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN"
          asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
        else
          echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN > $R/sup.log 2>&1   (started directly as $TU with no session: R0 changes nothing)"
          asuser $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN > $R/sup.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
          echo '$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-'$RUN'-unit -p Delegate=yes --working-directory='$D' '$NODE' '$D'/supervisor.cjs obtain '$RUN; asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN-unit -p Delegate=yes --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
        fi;;
    rl) echo "\$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN"
        asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?";;
    rs) echo "\$ systemctl start fx1459-rs@$c.service"; systemctl start fx1459-rs@$c.service; echo "exit $?";;
  esac
  waitlog $R/sup.log 'READY|RESULT' 30; recnew "$RUN-supervisor"
  say "supervisor log so far:"; cat $R/sup.log; supinfo
  if grep -q 'RESULT' $R/sup.log; then say "RESULT for $RUN: $(grep RESULT $R/sup.log)"; recnew "$RUN-end"; return; fi
  [[ -z $SUP ]] && { say "no supervisor record; abandoning $RUN"; end_survivors; return; }
  say "supervisor pid $SUP starttime $SUPST tree $TREE"
  case $c in
    n1) login_state "$RUN: tree running, before the cgroup.kill write"
        touch $R/go; say "trigger written"; waitlog $R/sup.log 'DONE' 40; say "supervisor log:"; sed -n '/trigger seen/,$p' $R/sup.log
        listing "after DONE, at least 12 s after the write";;
    n3) login_state "$RUN: tree running, before the kill"
        listing "before kill -9 of the supervisor"
        if alive_rec $SUP $SUPST; then say "\$ kill -9 $SUP"; kill -9 $SUP; say "kill -9 sent to recorded supervisor $SUP"; fi
        sleep 12; listing "12 s after kill -9 of the supervisor, before the fresh write"
        login_state "$RUN: supervisor killed, before the fresh write"
        echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE"; asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE 2>&1
        sleep 12; listing "12 s after the fresh write";;
    n2) say "supervisor started under the open session; now close every session of $TU"
        wait $H; say "interop login command exited ($?); sessions of $TU: $(tu_sessions | tr '\n' ' ')"
        sleep 2; for s in $(tu_sessions); do say "\$ loginctl terminate-session $s   (its leader is the spike's own login, recorded above)"; loginctl terminate-session $s; echo "exit $?"; done
        for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ -z $(tu_sessions) ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done
        CLOSED=$(now); say "every session of $TU closed at $CLOSED (tu_sessions empty: $([[ -z $(tu_sessions) ]] && echo yes || echo no))"
        for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; a=$(asuser $NODE $D/list.cjs $RUN watch | sed -n 's/.*alive=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p'); echo "$(now) t+${i}s after close: members alive=$a supervisor $(alive_rec $SUP $SUPST && echo alive || echo gone) user@$TUID $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service)"; done
        login_state "$RUN: 30 s after every session closed, before the cgroup.kill write"
        listing "30 s after every session closed, before the cgroup.kill write"
        if alive_rec $SUP $SUPST; then touch $R/go; say "trigger written"; waitlog $R/sup.log 'DONE' 40; say "supervisor log:"; sed -n '/trigger seen/,$p' $R/sup.log
        else say "supervisor $SUP is gone; supervisor log:"; cat $R/sup.log
          if [[ -d $TREE ]]; then echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE"; asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE 2>&1; else say "tree cgroup $TREE does not exist: \$ ls -ld $TREE"; ls -ld $TREE 2>&1; fi
          sleep 12; fi
        listing "at least 12 s after the ending"
        echo "\$ journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso-precise --since @${CASEST} _SYSTEMD_UNIT=systemd-logind.service + UNIT=user@$TUID.service + _SYSTEMD_UNIT=user@$TUID.service"
        journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso-precise --since @${CASEST} _SYSTEMD_UNIT=systemd-logind.service + UNIT=user@$TUID.service + _SYSTEMD_UNIT=user@$TUID.service 2>&1 | tail -60;;
  esac
  recnew "$RUN-end"
  end_survivors
  [[ $ROUTE == rs ]] && { systemctl stop fx1459-rs@$c.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed fx1459-rs@$c.service 2>/dev/null; }
  [[ $ROUTE != rs ]] && systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service >/dev/null && asuser systemctl --user reset-failed fx1459-$RUN.service 2>/dev/null
  sleep 1; listing "after cleanup"; wsl_alive "case $RUN end"
}
for c in $CASES; do CASEST=${EPOCHREALTIME%.*}; run_case $c; done
recnew "end"; login_state "route $ROUTE, end"; winrec end; wsl_alive end; say "driver done"
}
# main is read in full before it runs, and runs with stdin from /dev/null, so no command it starts can read the rest of this script.
main "$@" < /dev/null

<<<
# ABOUTME: Card #1459 helpers inlined at the top of every root script sent to WSL: UTC timestamps, the process record (pid,
# starttime, boot id), login-state reads, and a scan that records only the spike's own processes.
export TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C
TU=rigger-spike
D=/home/$TU/1459-spike-engineer
RECF=$D/record.txt
NODE=$D/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin/node
BOOT=$(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
while read -r k v; do [[ $k == btime ]] && BT=$v; done < /proc/stat
now(){ local t=$EPOCHREALTIME; printf '%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%sZ' "${t%.*}" "${t#*.}"; }
say(){ echo "$(now) $*"; }
declare -A SEEN
# cmdl <pid>: the process's argv joined by spaces, cut to 80 characters, in REPLY (bash builtins only).
cmdl(){ local -a a; { mapfile -d '' -t a < /proc/$1/cmdline; } 2>/dev/null; REPLY="${a[*]}"; REPLY=${REPLY:0:80}; }
# st <pid>: sets STF to the fields of /proc/<pid>/stat after the command name (STF[1] ppid, STF[19] starttime). Fails if gone.
st(){ local raw; { raw=$(</proc/$1/stat); } 2>/dev/null || return 1; STF=(${raw##*) }); }
# rp <label> <pid>: record one process by pid and starttime (field 22 of /proc/<pid>/stat, clock ticks since the VM's boot).
rp(){
  st "$2" || { say "REC-MISS label=$1 pid=$2 (gone before it could be read)"; return 0; }
  local s=${STF[19]} key="$2:${STF[19]}"; [[ -n ${SEEN[$key]} ]] && return 0; SEEN[$key]=1
  local cs=$(( BT*100 + s )) line
  printf -v line 'REC host=wsl boot=%s pid=%s starttime=%s created=%(%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)T.%02dZ recorded=%s label=%s' "$BOOT" "$2" "$s" "$((cs/100))" "$((cs%100))" "$(now)" "$1"
  echo "$line"; [[ -d $D ]] && echo "$line" >> "$RECF"
}
# mine <pid>: true if the process is the spike's own: a descendant of this script, owned by the user under test, in an fx1459
# unit or the user under test's slice, or in root's user slice and started no earlier than 3 s before this script.
mine(){
  local p=$1 cg u; { cg=$(</proc/$p/cgroup); } 2>/dev/null || return 1
  case $cg in *fx1459*|*user-$TUID.slice*) return 0;; esac
  u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null); [[ -n $TUID && $u == "$TUID" ]] && return 0
  if [[ $cg == *user-0.slice* ]]; then st $p && (( STF[19] >= MYST - 300 )) && return 0; fi
  local q=$p n=0; while (( q > 1 && n < 64 )); do [[ $q == "$$" ]] && return 0; st $q || return 1; q=${STF[1]}; ((n++)); done
  return 1
}
# recnew <label>: record every live process of the spike's own (see mine) not yet recorded.
recnew(){ local p; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; mine $p && { cmdl $p; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; }; done; }
# recboot <label>: when this connection started the distro, record every process of that start except [name withheld]'s (uid 1000) and
# sshd's per-connection processes, which belong to [name withheld]'s own sessions and user manager and are not the spike's.
recboot(){ local p u; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do p=${p#/proc/}; [[ $p == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; u=$(stat -c %u /proc/$p 2>/dev/null) || continue; [[ $u == 1000 ]] && continue; cmdl $p; [[ $REPLY == [name withheld]* ]] && continue; rp "$1:$REPLY" "$p"; done; }
# start_record: record this script and its /init parents; and, if the distro's pid 1 started less than 10 s before this
# script, every process of that distro start (recboot); then the spike's own processes.
start_record(){
  st $$; MYST=${STF[19]}; st 1; P1ST=${STF[19]}; TUID=$(id -u $TU 2>/dev/null)
  say "script pid $$ ppid $PPID starttime $MYST; distro pid 1 starttime $P1ST; boot_id $BOOT btime $BT; user under test $TU uid ${TUID:-none}"
  rp "script:$TAG" $$; rp "init-parent" $PPID; st $PPID; rp "init-grandparent" "${STF[1]}"
  if (( MYST - P1ST < 1000 )); then say "this connection started the distro (pid 1 started $((MYST - P1ST)) ticks before this script): recording that start, except [name withheld]'s processes"; recboot "boot"; fi
  recnew "start"
}
# winrec <label>: record, through interop, this connection's Windows process chain and any WSL VM process started since it began.
winrec(){ say "winrec $1"; /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand "$(sed "s/__TAG__/$TAG/;s/__LABEL__/$1/" $D/winrec.ps1 | iconv -t UTF-16LE | base64 -w0)" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | grep -v -e '^#< CLIXML' -e '^<Objs' | tee -a "$RECF"; }
login_state(){
  say "LOGIN STATE ($1)"; echo '$ loginctl list-sessions --no-pager'; loginctl list-sessions --no-pager
  echo "\$ loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service"; loginctl show-user $TU --no-pager -p State -p Sessions -p Linger -p Service 2>&1
  echo "\$ systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service"; systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service
}
wsl_alive(){ st 1; say "WSL instance ($1): boot_id $(</proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); distro pid 1 starttime ${STF[19]}; uptime $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime) s"; }
# tu_sessions: ids of the user under test's sessions other than its user manager's own (class manager).
tu_sessions(){ loginctl list-sessions --no-legend --no-pager | awk -v u=$TU '$3==u && $6!="manager" {print $1}'; }
# ---- case driver body. Arguments: <tag> <route r0|rl|rs> <cases...>. Runs each case for the user under test, as root only to
# set up or revert the route and to observe; every supervisor and fresh writer runs as the user under test.
main(){
TAG=$1; ROUTE=$2; shift 2; CASES="$*"
start_record; winrec start; wsl_alive start
UNITF=/etc/systemd/system/fx1459-rs@.service
asuser(){ setpriv --reuid=$TUID --regid=$TUID --init-groups env -i HOME=/home/$TU USER=$TU LOGNAME=$TU PATH=/usr/bin:/bin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$TUID "$@"; }
revert(){
  case $ROUTE in
    rl) say '$ loginctl disable-linger rigger-spike'; loginctl disable-linger $TU; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger;;
    rs) say "revert RS"; systemctl stop 'fx1459-rs@*.service' 2>&1; systemctl reset-failed 'fx1459-rs@*.service' 2>&1; rm -v $UNITF; systemctl daemon-reload; echo '$ systemctl cat fx1459-rs@x.service'; systemctl cat fx1459-rs@x.service 2>&1; ls -la $UNITF 2>&1;;
  esac
}
say "=== ROUTE $ROUTE setup"
login_state "route $ROUTE, before setup"
case $ROUTE in
  r0) echo "R0: the user as created, linger unset"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger;;
  rl) trap revert EXIT; say '$ loginctl enable-linger rigger-spike'; loginctl enable-linger $TU; echo "exit $?"; ls -la /var/lib/systemd/linger
      for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service) == active ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done; say "user@$TUID: $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service)"; recnew "rl-setup";;
  rs) trap revert EXIT; say "install $UNITF"
      cat > $UNITF <<UNIT
# ABOUTME: Card #1459 route RS: a system unit that runs the supervisor as the unprivileged user under test with a delegated cgroup.
[Unit]
Description=fx1459 RS supervisor %i
[Service]
Type=simple
User=$TU
Group=$TU
Delegate=yes
KillMode=process
WorkingDirectory=$D
ExecStart=$NODE $D/supervisor.cjs %i rs-%i
StandardOutput=append:$D/runs/rs-%i/sup.log
StandardError=append:$D/runs/rs-%i/sup.log
UNIT
      cat $UNITF; systemctl daemon-reload; echo "daemon-reload exit $?";;
esac
waitlog(){ local f=$1 pat=$2 n=$3; for ((i=0;i<n*10;i++)); do grep -qE "$pat" $f 2>/dev/null && return 0; sleep 0.1; done; return 1; }
alive_rec(){ st $1 && [[ ${STF[19]} == "$2" && ${STF[0]} != Z ]]; }
supinfo(){ local l; l=$(grep -m1 '^REC .*label=supervisor:' $R/sup.log); SUP=$(sed -E 's/.* pid=([0-9]+) .*/\1/' <<<"$l"); SUPST=$(sed -E 's/.* starttime=([0-9]+) .*/\1/' <<<"$l"); TREE=$(grep -m1 ' TREE ' $R/sup.log | awk '{print $3}'); }
listing(){ asuser $NODE $D/list.cjs $RUN "driver: $1" 2>&1; }
end_survivors(){
  local who pid start
  while read -r _ who pid start _; do [[ $who == *from-root* ]] && continue; if alive_rec $pid $start; then kill -9 $pid && say "cleanup: ended recorded $who pid $pid (starttime $start)"; fi; done < <(grep '^MEMBER' $R/members.txt 2>/dev/null)
  [[ -n $SUP ]] && alive_rec $SUP $SUPST && kill -9 $SUP && say "cleanup: ended recorded supervisor $SUP"
}
run_case(){
  local c=$1 mode=$1; RUN=$ROUTE-$c; R=$D/runs/$RUN; SUP=; SUPST=; TREE=; H=
  mkdir -p $R; chown $TU:$TU $R
  say "=== CASE $c under $ROUTE (run $RUN)"; wsl_alive "case $RUN start"
  if [[ $c == n2 ]]; then
    say "N2: open a $TU login session through WSL interop: wsl.exe -u $TU -e sleep 8"
    /mnt/c/Windows/System32/wsl.exe -u $TU -e sleep 8 & H=$!; rp "interop wsl.exe shim, $RUN login" $H
    for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ -n $(tu_sessions) ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done; recnew "$RUN-login"
    login_state "$RUN: session open, before supervisor start"
  else
    login_state "$RUN: during the run, before supervisor start"
    if [[ -n $(tu_sessions) ]]; then say "ABORT $RUN: $TU has a login session open"; return; fi
  fi
  if [[ $ROUTE == r0 && $c != n2 ]]; then mode=obtain; fi
  say "start supervisor (mode $mode)"
  case $ROUTE in
    r0) if [[ $c == n2 ]]; then
          echo "\$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN"
          asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
        else
          echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN > $R/sup.log 2>&1   (started directly as $TU with no session: R0 changes nothing)"
          asuser $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN > $R/sup.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
          echo '$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-'$RUN'-unit -p Delegate=yes --working-directory='$D' '$NODE' '$D'/supervisor.cjs obtain '$RUN; asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN-unit -p Delegate=yes --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs obtain $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
        fi;;
    rl) echo "\$ asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN"
        asuser systemd-run --user --unit=fx1459-$RUN -p Delegate=yes -p KillMode=process -p StandardOutput=append:$R/sup.log -p StandardError=append:$R/sup.log --working-directory=$D $NODE $D/supervisor.cjs $mode $RUN 2>&1; echo "exit $?";;
    rs) echo "\$ systemctl start fx1459-rs@$c.service"; systemctl start fx1459-rs@$c.service; echo "exit $?";;
  esac
  waitlog $R/sup.log 'READY|RESULT' 30; recnew "$RUN-supervisor"
  say "supervisor log so far:"; cat $R/sup.log; supinfo
  if grep -q 'RESULT' $R/sup.log; then say "RESULT for $RUN: $(grep RESULT $R/sup.log)"; recnew "$RUN-end"; return; fi
  [[ -z $SUP ]] && { say "no supervisor record; abandoning $RUN"; end_survivors; return; }
  say "supervisor pid $SUP starttime $SUPST tree $TREE"
  case $c in
    n1) login_state "$RUN: tree running, before the cgroup.kill write"
        touch $R/go; say "trigger written"; waitlog $R/sup.log 'DONE' 40; say "supervisor log:"; sed -n '/trigger seen/,$p' $R/sup.log
        listing "after DONE, at least 12 s after the write";;
    n3) login_state "$RUN: tree running, before the kill"
        listing "before kill -9 of the supervisor"
        if alive_rec $SUP $SUPST; then say "\$ kill -9 $SUP"; kill -9 $SUP; say "kill -9 sent to recorded supervisor $SUP"; fi
        sleep 12; listing "12 s after kill -9 of the supervisor, before the fresh write"
        login_state "$RUN: supervisor killed, before the fresh write"
        echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE"; asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE 2>&1
        sleep 12; listing "12 s after the fresh write";;
    n2) say "supervisor started under the open session; now close every session of $TU"
        wait $H; say "interop login command exited ($?); sessions of $TU: $(tu_sessions | tr '\n' ' ')"
        sleep 2; for s in $(tu_sessions); do say "\$ loginctl terminate-session $s   (its leader is the spike's own login, recorded above)"; loginctl terminate-session $s; echo "exit $?"; done
        for i in $(seq 1 50); do [[ -z $(tu_sessions) ]] && break; sleep 0.2; done
        CLOSED=$(now); say "every session of $TU closed at $CLOSED (tu_sessions empty: $([[ -z $(tu_sessions) ]] && echo yes || echo no))"
        for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; a=$(asuser $NODE $D/list.cjs $RUN watch | sed -n 's/.*alive=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p'); echo "$(now) t+${i}s after close: members alive=$a supervisor $(alive_rec $SUP $SUPST && echo alive || echo gone) user@$TUID $(systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service)"; done
        login_state "$RUN: 30 s after every session closed, before the cgroup.kill write"
        listing "30 s after every session closed, before the cgroup.kill write"
        if alive_rec $SUP $SUPST; then touch $R/go; say "trigger written"; waitlog $R/sup.log 'DONE' 40; say "supervisor log:"; sed -n '/trigger seen/,$p' $R/sup.log
        else say "supervisor $SUP is gone; supervisor log:"; cat $R/sup.log
          if [[ -d $TREE ]]; then echo "\$ asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE"; asuser $NODE $D/writer.cjs $RUN $TREE 2>&1; else say "tree cgroup $TREE does not exist: \$ ls -ld $TREE"; ls -ld $TREE 2>&1; fi
          sleep 12; fi
        listing "at least 12 s after the ending"
        echo "\$ journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso-precise --since @${CASEST} _SYSTEMD_UNIT=systemd-logind.service + UNIT=user@$TUID.service + _SYSTEMD_UNIT=user@$TUID.service"
        journalctl --no-pager -o short-iso-precise --since @${CASEST} _SYSTEMD_UNIT=systemd-logind.service + UNIT=user@$TUID.service + _SYSTEMD_UNIT=user@$TUID.service 2>&1 | tail -60;;
  esac
  recnew "$RUN-end"
  end_survivors
  [[ $ROUTE == rs ]] && { systemctl stop fx1459-rs@$c.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed fx1459-rs@$c.service 2>/dev/null; }
  [[ $ROUTE != rs ]] && systemctl is-active user@$TUID.service >/dev/null && asuser systemctl --user reset-failed fx1459-$RUN.service 2>/dev/null
  sleep 1; listing "after cleanup"; wsl_alive "case $RUN end"
}
for c in $CASES; do CASEST=${EPOCHREALTIME%.*}; run_case $c; done
recnew "end"; login_state "route $ROUTE, end"; winrec end; wsl_alive end; say "driver done"
}
# main is read in full before it runs, and runs with stdin from /dev/null, so no command it starts can read the rest of this script.
main "$@" < /dev/null
